subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Remember to insure your vehicle before you __drive it__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is grammatically **correct and does not require any changes.**
 
• "Insure" is the correct term to use when referring to obtaining insurance for a vehicle.
 
• The structure of the sentence is clear and precise, conveying the intended meaning effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Remember to insure your vehicle before you drive it."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "driving it" **– This option changes the structure of the sentence and is not necessary.
 
• **Option 2: "drove it"** – This option changes the tense and meaning of the sentence, making it incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "driven it"** – This option is also grammatically incorrect in the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "No improvement"** – This is the correct option as the original sentence is already correct.
